title: Lockheed engineer: 'This is what you learn when you die'

tellings.quote: Ben Rich said something else. This was somebody else then. Ben Rich was kind of pro. This guy was conh and he said, "No, we don't you're not supposed to learn about this. This is what you learn about when you die."

plain: An engineer at Lockheed, the American aerospace company, is said to have told someone asking about UFOs, "you're not supposed to learn about this. This is what you learn about when you die." The writer Peter Levenda tells it, taken from a book by a man named John B. Alexander, and says it was not Lockheed's Ben Rich, who was more open on the subject, but another man who was against talking. It suggests insiders treated the subject as off limits for life.
